comparison.objective: Grind a measured batch of peppercorns to specified coarse and fine mass fractions.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply sustained downward force and circular or impact pestle motion while containing material.
comparison.success_condition: Specified sieve fractions are reached with limited loss and the pestle safely released.
comparison.reason: Grinding and granular containment do not exercise coupled screw/nut adjustment, countertorque, or retained articulated motion.
